output.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: single detailed colored completion illustration for the Picross album, NOT the puzzle grid. Warm calm hand-drawn 2D illustration, clean dark confident contours, substantial coherent colored areas, carefully drawn material details and restrained soft shading. One Japanese teapot only, fully visible centered on a plain warm ivory background. Landscape 3:2 composition. Generous but not excessive margins, teapot fills most width and height. Slightly elevated three-quarter view with a clear broad silhouette, lid and short spout visibly differentiated. Detailed finished artwork, not pixel art, not an icon or monochrome silhouette. No text, labels, watermark, grid, cups, tea leaves, steam, flowers, table scenery or other props. No photorealism, 3D or noisy sketching. Large forms and important negative spaces should remain readable if later abstracted to around 30 by 20 cells, without drawing cells or prematurely simplifying this illustration. Variant B: Japanese cast-iron teapot, broad squat gently rounded dark forest-green body, with a short elegant spout to the left and a single substantial tall arched dark handle mounted above the body. Wide clear ivory negative space inside the handle above the fitted shallow round lid; the handle must not overlap or hide the lid knob. A round knob on lid, two clearly joined handle lugs, delicate orderly raised hobnail texture and an understated horizontal cast seam on the body. Restrained moss-green highlights and warm dark outlines; very broad simple mass under the arched handle. No gold ornament, no symbols.
